findings.requirement: Every Android target and applicable built manifest must use minSdk >= 24.
evidence: shared/component/build.gradle.kts:13, shared/compose/build.gradle.kts:115, shared/data/build.gradle.kts:15, shared/domain/build.gradle.kts:13, shared/platform/build.gradle.kts:13 and shared/root/build.gradle.kts:13 declare minSdk = 23.
Their build/intermediates/merged_manifest/androidMain/processAndroidMainManifest/AndroidManifest.xml files also contain minSdkVersion 23.
The independent check failed with exitCode 1: .vibe/receipts/RECEIPT-ba7a28f9-6b14-44bc-ace4-61323791c4d8.json.
App debug/release manifests and the installed package use 24; that does not satisfy the target-wide contract.
findings.remediation: Raise the six shared targets to the required floor, rebuild affected manifests and recheck. Inspect the release AAB base manifest when distribution is activated.

findings.requirement: Prove accessible task operation, logical spoken/focus order, keyboard operation and applicable Android native behavior.
evidence: AccessibilityContractTest.interactiveRendererDeclaresMinimumTargetsRolesErrorsAndStateDescriptions checks source substrings rather than rendered semantics or task operation.
build/reports/requirements-fixes-20261017/runtime/runtime-summary.json explicitly leaves TalkBack spoken content/order and next-item traversal unverified.

Current checkpoint proves service binding, labels, one hardware-Tab editor focus, IME/back behavior, setup, documents, reset and restore; it does not prove the full core-screen keyboard/adaptive matrix.
Shared reminder tests use recording/fake drivers. The current native checkpoint does not establish actual daily/soak delivery, restart and time-zone reconciliation on the installed APK.
findings.remediation: Complete a current exact-APK Android runtime matrix with observed TalkBack traversal/output, keyboard task completion and native reminder delivery/reconciliation. Retain behavioral assertions rather than treating service binding or source tokens as success.

findings.requirement: Photo/database mutations must preserve the previous consistent state on cancellation and failure.
evidence: shared/data/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sedsoftware/sproutpace/data/BackupAndExport.kt: LocalWorkspaceRepository.saveObservation, deleteObservation and deleteBatch mutate files and database sequentially.
Their compensation executes in the original coroutine context, unlike LocalBackupService replacement/erase compensation which explicitly uses NonCancellable.

Cancellation after removing a photo but before LocalDatabase.deleteObservation/deleteBatch enters withContext(ioDispatcher) can leave the row intact. Restoring via AndroidPrivateFileStore.write then calls ensureActive in the cancelled context and can fail.
Existing ordinary failure/restart assertions do not inject cancellation at these photo/row commit boundaries.
findings.remediation: Make local observation/photo and cascade-delete compensation cancellation-safe, preserve the original cause, and add cancellation-boundary tests asserting exact row/file restoration.

findings.requirement: SCREEN-009 must preview selected, replaced and committed photos, including the expanded photo presentation.
evidence: ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer.observationSnapshot carries observation items with ScreenPhoto bytes.
ContextualFormsScreen.ContextualEditor renders header, fields and actions but never renders the observation photo items.
ScreenContent.PlatformPickerField renders selection-status text and Choose/Replace/Remove controls only.
Inspected current 09_actual_photo_dark and 09_actual_photo_expanded goldens show 'Private photo selected' without an image.
findings.remediation: Render an accessible bounded photo preview from the selected/pending image state in the production editor; inspect and verify the intentional golden changes.

findings.requirement: Today must remain authoritative as actions become due/overdue and local dates advance.
evidence: ProductionScreenDataManager.watch combines workspaceFlow and settingsFlow only.
ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer.actionItem calculates TaskDayGroup from now() and today() only when that combination emits.

StoredScreenComponent retains one Store observation across pause/resume; ProductionAppGraph.onResume refreshes reminder/permission state but does not invalidate the underlying time-derived screen snapshot.
An open unchanged Today screen therefore has no clock-driven path to refresh its due grouping; existing fixed-time snapshots do not test this subscription boundary.
findings.remediation: Introduce a lifecycle-aware clock/date invalidation path and assert retained Today updates across due-time and midnight boundaries without a database or preference write.

findings.requirement: Current macOS CI, Xcode linkage and native iOS runtime evidence remain required.
evidence: The immutable request declares exactly four unavailable obligation/surface pairs.
Current matrix includes Kotlin iosArm64 and iosSimulatorArm64 compilation, which does not execute simulator tests or xcodebuild.
.github/workflows/AnalysisAndTest.yml configures macOS tasks, but no current completed macOS execution was supplied.
findings.remediation: Obtain current macOS CI/Xcode and native platform results for the frozen implementation; retain these pairs as unavailable until then.

findings.requirement: Both platforms must persist civil schedule changes when the system time zone changes while preserving elapsed soak instants.
evidence: AndroidReminderDriver routes ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED through reconcileReminderEnvironment.
The shared reconcileReminderEnvironment function persists the time-zone-change command before physical reconciliation.
IosProductionAppGraph exposes lifecycle/permission methods only; its onResume delegates to ProductionAppGraph.onResume, which does not call that persisted environment bridge.
iosApp.swift has no time-zone-change observer/bridge to this shared reconciliation. Native permission refresh is a separate path.
SchedulingEngine and shared time-zone tests prove the algorithm when called, not the missing iOS invocation.
findings.remediation: Wire iOS significant time-zone changes and resume reconciliation to the shared persisted civil-action bridge; add a wiring test and verify native behavior on macOS.

findings.requirement: Required localization checks include unsupported-locale English fallback and system locale changes.
evidence: AccessibilityContractTest checks EN/RU key equality; LocalizedTextContractTest checks resource-key resolution.
Preview tests execute fixed EN/RU configurations.
TimeZoneDisplayTest changes Java locale only for a time-zone display-name helper.
No assertion was found that renders production resources under an unsupported system locale or changes OS locale while preserving current product state.
findings.remediation: Add executable resource/runtime assertions for unsupported-locale English fallback and EN/RU system-locale switching, including native text where applicable.

findings.requirement: A new batch must show an overridable seed-mass recommendation derived from its selected tray area and recipe density before save.
evidence: ProductionScreenSnapshotRenderer.seedRecommendationItem returns a value only when stableId resolves to an already persisted batch.
ProductionScreenInteractionBuilder.primaryScreenFacts likewise emits recommended-seed-mass only for selected.batch.
New draft tray/culture edits stay in Store draft values and do not request a recalculated recommendation.
RecipeBatchCommandHandler.saveBatch calculates a default at save time, after the decision where guidance is needed.
ScreenComponentContractTest.ac026_seedRecommendationIsExposedAsEditableContent injects literal '12.5 g'; the manager test checks a recommendation on an existing batch.
findings.remediation: Project the recommendation from current new-batch draft selections, update it when tray/recipe changes, retain explicit overrides, and test the public editor before persistence.

findings.requirement: Every declared component-test surface needs meaningful assertions tied to the corresponding production scenario.
evidence: All affected pairs are explicitly marked gap in obligations.

ScreenComponentContractTest.assertCommandScenario constructs ScenarioManager with a supplied result and invokes ScreenAction.Execute directly. ScenarioManager returns that result independently of production manager behavior.
assertSnapshotScenario likewise supplies expected content; examples include a handwritten eight-culture list, two safety/source items and a literal seed recommendation.
Several other required component scenarios have only direct manager/database tests or preview-router/helper tests.

Real router-to-Store-to-manager-to-SQLite tests were recognized where present, including UiCompletenessProductionTest, ProductionLifecycleFlowTest and ProductionUxRegressionTest; those do not automatically prove unrelated scenarios.
findings.remediation: Close each listed component gap with focused public action/field/navigation assertions using production snapshot/command wiring and meaningful resulting-state checks. Keep existing isolated Store and manager tests as complementary layer evidence.
